text: Shristi Shrestha (Nepali: सृष्टि श्रेष्ठ, Listenⓘ) is a Nepalese actress, model, and beauty pageant titleholder who won the Miss Nepal 2012 pageant. She represented her home district of Chitwan as Miss Chitwan 2012 and won the main Miss Nepal title that year, along with the Miss Confidence title. Shrestha is the first Miss Nepal winner to reach the quarter-finals of Miss World, where she finished in 20th place overall, secured eighth place in Beach Beauty, and was among the top ten contestants for the Multimedia Award. She also won the Public Choice Award at the Miss World pageant. Her acting debut was in the Nepali film Gajalu, co-starring Anmol K.C. On stage, she made her debut as Ophelia in a production of William Shakespeare's Hamlet, staged at Theatre Village in Kathmandu for one month and produced by the British Council, directed by Gregory Thomson. Shrestha has received Best Debut Actor awards from the National Film Awards, the Kamana Film Awards, the Dcine Awards, and the FAAN Awards. She is the seventh Young Conservation Ambassador for WWF Nepal and is involved in snow leopard conservation projects within the organization. She was in a relationship with Saugat Malla from 2016 to early 2023. Premdhwoj Pradhan / Usha Mangeskar, Universe N/A, World Shristi Shrestha, International Subeksha Khadka, Earth Nagma Shrestha.
